findings: Signed Ordinance 2025-1864 section XVI expressly repeals Interim Ordinance 2024-1852-U in its entirety, including its extension and August 26 amendment; the mechanism is directly established, not inferred from permanent zoning adoption.

The signed adoption page records November 4,2025 adoption with five ayes and expressly prints December 5,2025 as both effective and operative date. Normalize that county-stated date rather than silently recomputing it.

Section XVII separately says effective 30 days after adoption. Preserve that wording alongside the explicit printed date; this review does not adjudicate legal day-counting or silently substitute December 4.
Minute order independently confirms November 4 adoption 5–0. Earlier August partial-lift and original-term history remain retained.
resolution: Historical source hold on remaining interim repeal and stated permanent-ordinance effect is resolved using executed ordinance and official minute order. Later legal force is outside this scoped historical finding.
scope: Two new substantive primary sources, three visually reviewed pages; no paid provider, model, browser or outreach.
